title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP progamme component 1 will be implemented in the Amhara and SNNPR regions. It focuses on food systems more broadly with the aim of diversifying food production and increasing the supply of nutrient dense foods. 3,000 households (18,000 beneficiaries) will be supported. Communities will be trained in Climate Smart Agriculture and sustainable agriculture techniques. This will include afforestation and tree planting, such as the planting of fruit trees for diversified diet and income. Drought tolerant crop varieties will be used, and irrigation systems established. Training will also be delivered on dietary diversity/nutrition, post harvesting handling, food processing and hygiene. There will be a strong focus on increasing women’s role in decision making particularly in relation to food production. Multi-stakeholder platforms, comprised of government officials and other key stakeholders, will be established and will meet quarterly to discuss issues relating to food security. The programme will also support green technologies such as the use of energy efficient stoves, youth led enterprises for the manufacture of organic fertiliser production/vermi-composting and youth led fruit tree cultivation.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: Equitable and inclusive food systems to support availability, access and consumption of safe nutritious food. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: A project in Ethiopia supporting small scale food production and climate smart agriculture practices to ensure access to safe and nutritious foods year round. Marked 2 for Adaptation.
